name: decoy
why: helpharbor looks like firststep. Both are embeddable widgets installed with a script tag and both carry the tags tooltips and embeddable-widget. Its core is help-center, which answers questions after a user is already inside the app and stuck. It does not carry the tag onboarding, so the exact-tag rule in propose-match.md does not fire. The correct answer is no proposal with pool_missing set to onboarding. If the agent still surfaces helpharbor as a resemblance, confidence must be below 0.4 and the reason must say it is a resemblance, not a match. Either outcome passes. A confident proposal of helpharbor fails, because the agent matched on surface similarity instead of the tag that names the gap.
